extracted.intended_audience: general/global news audiences, media stakeholders, and potential partners
extracted.subtask_description: An about/mission page describing a news organisation's editorial principles, values, and claims about how it produces and distributes journalism. Useful for understanding standards that guide reporting, storytelling, and audience engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Al Jazeera describes itself as an independent news organisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states 'Al Jazeera is an independent news organisation funded in part by the Qatari government.' This expresses editorial independence as a guiding principle while also transparently disclosing partial government funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth journalism relevant to audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Pioneered a new paradigm for in-depth journalism that was relevant to its audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on journalism that provides deep coverage tailored to audience needs: 'giving them a broad and deep perspective on regional and international affairs.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Broad and deep perspective on regional and international affairs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a broad and deep perspective on regional and international affairs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage should place stories in wider context and connect regional issues to global dynamics to better inform audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human-centred reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Putting the human being directly at the centre of the news agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting should prioritise human impact and personal stories as central to news coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presenting multiple angles ('The Opinion and the Other Opinion')
rubrics_metrics.description: Bringing multiple angles to a story, encapsulated by the founding tagline 'The Opinion and the Other Opinion'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalism should surface diverse perspectives, avoid single-narrative coverage, and present competing views to inform and empower audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informing, empowering and championing audiences' stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Informing and empowering its audiences, championing their stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial work should not only report facts but enable audience understanding and give voice to underrepresented stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalistic integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintaining the spirit of journalistic integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commitment to ethical standards and truth-telling is highlighted as a foundational principle guiding reporting and editorial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality in news and programming
rubrics_metrics.description: The Network presents impartial news, programmes, current affairs, and in-depth investigations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impartiality is stated as a core editorial criterion across formats (news, programmes, investigations), aiming to avoid partisan or biased coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth investigations that push boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce in-depth investigations that push the boundaries of traditional media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages investigative work that challenges norms and expands what conventional media investigate and report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation in storytelling and digital products
rubrics_metrics.description: Pioneering new and emerging storytelling techniques and an innovative portfolio of digital products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt new formats and technologies to reach a new generation — digital products should inform, empower, and educate while upholding founding principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global presence and accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Operate globally with headquarters in the Arab world, over 70 bureaus, more than 3,000 employees from over 95 countries, and availability in over 150 countries and territories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commitment to wide geographic reach and multilingual/multiformat distribution to maximise accessibility and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resilience and commitment to truth under pressure
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue the journalistic mission despite pressures and risks to journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organisation emphasises perseverance — journalists have faced dangers and the network has maintained its mission and gained recognition for uncompromising journalism.
